scope: Construction of four explicitly selected reinforced-concrete water-meter chambers WMC-RC-DN150-4-EMF with design flow 1200 m3/day, four electromagnetic meters EMF-DN150-PN16, 96 m of DN150 straight measuring pipe and 48 m of DN150 bypass pipe. Direct chambers, meters, valves, fittings, civil materials, labor, mechanisms, testing, metrology and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved water-meter chamber design, hydraulic calculation, chamber and piping drawings, equipment-valve schedule, meter manufacturer, metrology program, geotechnical report and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: village distribution network, intake, borehole, pumping or treatment station, reservoir, tower or sewer scope
valve, fitting, chamber, civil, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from flow, pipe length or diameter
automatic excavation shoring, groundwater dewatering or road reinstatement
universal retained spare or supplier-package quantity
